title: Seal Gate
next_chapter_hook: The Seal Gate slowly opened, and an ancient pressure leaked out from within. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that aura mixed within the pressure was actually of the same source as the Tianji Record Fragment.

text.content: In the middle layer of the ruins, the air suddenly became viscous, as if invisible threads were wrapping around their bodies. Chen Ji slightly paused his steps, his brow creasing subtly. A faint stinging sensation came from his fingertips—that was the Tianji Record Fragment gently trembling—it sensed something. "Three zhang ahead, there's a problem." He spoke in a low voice, his tone as calm as if discussing today's weather. Beside him, Ye Qing raised an eyebrow; the Demon Path Saint Woman's deep purple eyes flickered with cold light in the dimness. She didn't question, but instead raised her hand to condense a thin layer of black mist to protect her body. The two exchanged a glance, tacitly slowing their breaths. The walls of the ruins were covered with mottled runes, their lines simple and powerful, faintly exuding a heart-stopping pressure.

dialogue.content: "This formation... is an ancient tomb-guarding pattern." Ye Qing's voice was pressed extremely low, her tone unusually grave. "The Demon Path sects have related records, but no one has ever truly seen a physical example. Chen Ji, what reaction does your Fragment have?"

text.content: "Excessively intense." Chen Ji didn't hide it—the Tianji Record Fragment was currently burning in his chest like an iron brand, and every heartbeat was accompanied by a burning sting. He narrowed his eyes, and a flash of sharp light flickered in those seemingly turbid eyes. "This formation isn't just used to block intruders; it's... screening." Before the words finished, the ground suddenly lit up with a blinding light. Those dormant runes seemed to awaken, beginning to spread along the walls and floor, instantly weaving a tight net of light that enveloped the two of them. The air suddenly solidified, and a pressure beyond imagination squeezed in from all directions.

Ye Qing's expression slightly changed. Her Demon Path mist was compressed backward by that pressure, the protective black qi visibly thinning. "This pressure... is at least at the Nascent Soul level!" She gritted her teeth, fine beads of sweat forming at her temples. "No, it's stronger than Nascent Soul—it's half-step to Deity Transformation!" Yet Chen Ji showed no panic. His gaze quickly swept through the light net, those runes seemingly chaotic but actually hiding profound mysteries—every beam of light had a traceable transmission path, every flicker following some ancient law.

"Interesting." He spoke lightly, even a faint smile curving his lips.

"You can still laugh?!" Ye Qing glared at him, a flash of irritation flickering in her eyes.

"Of course." Chen Ji turned to look at her, his tone decisive. "This formation tests the cooperation of two people, not pure brute force. If we force our way through, anyone below Deity Transformation will surely die; but if we find the pattern—" He paused. "I already have the answer."

dialogue.content: "I need you to cooperate with me." Chen Ji's voice was steady and certain, entirely different from his usual waste of a persona. "Later I'll tell you left or right, strike or withdraw. You only need to do one thing—trust me." Ye Qing stared at him for three breaths. Complex and indecipherable emotions flickered in those deep purple eyes. Trust, for a Demon Path person, was the most luxurious thing. She had been controlled and used by the Holy Sect for many years, long accustomed to maintaining vigilance against everyone. Yet at this moment, facing this young face, she actually saw an odd certainty in those deep eyes—not the arrogance of the ignorant, but absolute confidence沉淀 after countless life-and-death experiences. She suddenly remembered the prophecy Chen Ji had shown her using the Tianji Record—that image only she could understand... "Fine." She spoke, her voice calmer than expected. "I trust you."

text.content:
The moment the words fell, Chen Ji moved.

His figure flickered like a ghost, his feet stepping on an odd rhythm, each step landing precisely in the gaps of the light net. At the same time, his voice sounded in Ye Qing's ear: "Qian position, three zhang, strike!" Without hesitation, Ye Qing directed the Demon Path mist at her fingertips to transform into a blade, fiercely slashing toward the position Chen Ji designated. With a boom, light exploded, revealing a narrow gap. "Zhen position, move left two steps, withdraw!" Chen Ji's instructions remained succinct and accurate. Ye Qing followed, retreating just in time to dodge the rune light arrows shooting out from the gap. Their coordination was as seamless as if rehearsed countless times.

However, the formation's counterattack was just beginning.

A blinding pillar of light rose from the formation's eye, directly heading toward where the two stood. "Kan position, retreat!" Chen Ji grabbed Ye Qing's wrist and pulled her backward, while sidestepping himself. The pillar of light whistled past their clothes, its scorching heat leaving a burning sting on their skin. "This formation has a self-repair function," Chen Ji's voice grew urgent, "the path we just took is being sealed off. We must—" He suddenly stopped, his pupils slightly contracted.

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled, an unprecedented stream of information flooding into his mind. Not foresight, but a sealed memory—the memory belonging to this formation's creator.

dialogue.content:
"...This formation," a hoarse and majestic voice spoke in the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness, "requires two people to simultaneously activate the formation's eye, and they must be hearts of one mind. That Demon Path companion of yours..." The voice paused, carrying a hint of amusement. "She trusts you more than she herself realizes."

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, meeting Ye Qing's anxious gaze. "What's wrong? Your expression is so grim." She frowned and asked.

"Nothing," Chen Ji shook his head, a meaningful smile curving his lips. "I just found the key to breaking the formation."

text.content: He released Ye Qing's wrist, pointing to the brightest position ahead—where there were two adjacent recesses, shaped like yin-yang fish. "This formation is called 'Tongxin Seal'," he quickly explained, "requiring two people to simultaneously inject spiritual power into the formation's eye, and they must maintain absolute意念 synchronization." He looked at Ye Qing, his expression serious. "The next step is crucial. I need you to completely empty your mind, with no stray thoughts. Can you do it?" Ye Qing met his gaze. A complex expression flickered in those deep purple eyes, finally turning into a sigh: "At this point, can I say no?" She extended her hand, her fingertips condensing a pure mass of Demon Path spiritual power. Chen Ji nodded, similarly mobilizing the spiritual power within him—the moment that power gathered at his fingertips, it actually faintly glowed with a trace of golden light, forming a stark contrast with Ye Qing's black spiritual power.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, casting aside all stray thoughts. At that moment, he could clearly sense Ye Qing's existence—her heartbeat, her breath, that hint of uneasiness deep in her heart... The moment their spiritual powers met at their fingertips, the yin and yang poles suddenly merged. With a thunderous boom, a massive pillar of light shot skyward, illuminating the entire formation. Within the light, Ye Qing opened her eyes, and there was something more in her gaze when she looked at the man beside her.

dialogue.content:
"You..." Her voice was somewhat hoarse. "Just now, I seemed to truly sense your existence. Not spiritually, but..." She didn't finish, but a hint of panic clearly flickered in those deep purple eyes.

Chen Ji simply smiled faintly: "The formation is broken. Focus."

text.content: However, after the light dissipated, the scene before them made both pause simultaneously. Where the formation had disappeared, a staircase extending downward was revealed. On both sides of the staircase, the walls were covered with densely packed ancient runes, those runes emanating a faint blue glow that illuminated the entire passage like a dream. And at the end of the staircase, a massive stone gate stood quietly, with three simple ancient characters carved on it—"Seal Gate".

text.content: While emptying his mind, Chen Ji quietly retained a thread of vigilance in the depths of his consciousness. He could feel Ye Qing's thoughts surging like a tide—sincere, resolute, even carrying a hint of dependence she herself had not yet noticed. The thought was so genuine that it made the sliver of wariness in his heart appear particularly jarring—and particularly necessary.

dialogue.content:
"Thought synchronization rate... only seventy percent." Chen Ji spoke in a low voice, his tone carrying a hint of helplessness. The formation's response confirmed his worries—the light pillar rose but was clearly far less brilliant than anticipated, the runes flickering intermittently as if they might extinguish at any moment.

"It's my problem." Ye Qing's voice sounded somewhat dejected, "I... I'm not used to fully trusting someone." She lowered her head, not daring to meet Chen Ji's eyes.

"No matter." Chen Ji said calmly, "Seventy percent is enough." His finger suddenly pressed toward the formation's eye, and a torrential surge of spiritual energy poured out, forcibly stabilizing those swaying runes. At the same time, Ye Qing moved as well—her Demonic Path mist transformed into a black torrent, filling the missing corner of the Yin-Yang formation. A rumble echoed as the seal on the stone door finally loosened by a crack.

"This price..." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a meaningful tone, "you'll remember it."

text.content: The price was indeed significant. The chain reaction of the formation caused Chen Ji's blood and qi to surge violently, a metallic taste rising in his throat, which he forced himself to swallow. And as the stone door slowly opened, an extremely cold aura rushed toward him, mixed with some ancient and mysterious aura. The Tianji Record Fragment's trembling reached its peak at this moment, as if desperately trying to convey some message to him. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted—that aura shared the same source as the fragment. No, to be precise, the thing sealed behind this door was itself... part of the Tianji Record.

choices.memory_label: 首次合作中出现配合瑕疵

text.content:
At the end of the stairs stood the Sealed Door, towering majestically.

The stone door was about three zhang high and over two zhang wide, its surface covered with dense runes, each emitting a faint blue glow. The door was tightly shut, yet an invisible force radiated from within, causing one's heart to palpitate. Chen Ji walked forward slowly, and with each step closer, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled more intensely. He could feel that something extremely important was sealed behind that door—important enough to drive the Tianji Record itself to madness. "Be careful." Ye Qing's voice came from behind him, tinged with tension, "I've never seen this method of sealing before. It seems like some kind of self-contained system of laws, completely different from any formation we know."

dialogue.content: "A system of laws?" Chen Ji repeated, his brow furrowing slightly. "Do you understand what that means?" Ye Qing walked to his side, and a rare hint of apprehension appeared in her violet eyes, "It means this isn't an ordinary seal, but a lock forged from 'Heavenly Dao Rules' themselves. If forcibly destroyed..." She paused, "the entire ruins might collapse." Chen Ji said nothing, merely gazing quietly at the stone door. The Tianji Record Fragment's trembling had become a burning, excruciating pain, as if urging him to open this door quickly. But he knew—the more critical the moment, the more he couldn't act rashly. Mo Xiansheng's words still echoed in his ears—"The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the deadly backlash of fate." What exactly lay behind this door?

text.content:
He extended his hand, fingertips gently touching the stone door's surface. In that instant, an icy, piercing sensation spread from his fingertips throughout his entire body. Chen Ji felt as if he had touched some ancient and profound existence—something dormant, yet still possessing the power to destroy heaven and earth. "There's a mechanism." He spoke, his voice steady, "Not a formation, but... a keyhole." Ye Qing moved closer to look, and indeed saw a fist-sized indentation in the center of the stone door, its shape unusual, as if composed of dozens of smaller runes. "A key is needed?" She frowned, "But we don't have—" Before she finished, Chen Ji had already taken an object from his chest. It was an antique jade pendant, completely black, its surface covered with the same runes as the stone door. It was precisely the key he had incidentally obtained at some ruins—he had never known what it was for until this moment.

"So that's how it is." Chen Ji spoke softly, a knowing curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, "This jade pendant was specially prepared for this door."

dialogue.content: "Wait." Ye Qing suddenly pressed his hand, a hint of wariness flickering in her violet eyes, "Aren't you afraid this is a trap? That jade pendant appeared at too convenient a time—who knows if someone purposely—" Chen Ji turned to look at her, his gaze as calm as a deep pool: "I know." Ye Qing was stunned. "But some doors," Chen Ji continued, his tone unhurried, "even knowing they are traps, must still be pushed open." He slowly inserted the jade pendant into the indentation. In the next moment, the runes on the stone door suddenly blazed brilliantly, a blinding blue light shooting skyward, and the entire ruins shook violently. Amidst the deafening rumbling, the door that had been sealed for ten thousand years finally began to slowly open.

text.content: Chen Ji did not recklessly step inside, but stood outside the threshold, carefully打量着门后的一切。那里是一个巨大的圆形祭坛，祭坛中央悬浮着一团幽蓝色的光芒，光芒中隐约可见某种器物的轮廓。而就在祭坛四周，环绕着数十具白骨，那些白骨保持着跪伏的姿态，仿佛在朝拜，又仿佛在哀求。"The layout is very deliberate," Chen Ji spoke in a low voice, a sharp light flashing in his eyes, "this altar itself is a formation, and a living one—it adjusts its pressure intensity based on the intruder's strength." Ye Qing followed his gaze, her complexion slightly changing: "Those white bones... in their lifetimes, they were probably all cultivators above the Divine Transformation realm."

"That's why we must be careful." Chen Ji nodded, "Cultivators below Divine Transformation died here. If we charge in recklessly—" Before he finished, the ball of blue light at the altar's center suddenly trembled violently. An ancient and majestic voice echoed out from within, reverberating through the entire space: "Tianji successor... you have finally arrived."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Tianji successor?

The voice seemed to pierce through his origins, continuing: "I am the third-generation keeper of the Tianji Record, leaving this remnant soul solely to await a destined person. Since you bear the fragment, you are qualified to inherit my legacy—" The voice paused, its tone suddenly turning cold, "But before that, you must first pass the final trial."

As the words fell, all the white bones around the altar suddenly stood up, their empty eye sockets blazing with blue flames. Dozens of skeletons surrounded Chen Ji and Ye Qing, releasing a suffocating pressure.

"The trial... begins now."

text.content:
Before Ye Qing could react, Chen Ji had already moved.

His form turned into a afterimage, directly dashing toward the altar's center. The Tianji Record Fragment burned madly within his body, providing him with speed and strength far beyond his normal limits. The pressure behind the door pressed down like a mountain, each step forward making his bones produce cracking sounds. But he didn't stop; instead, he accelerated.

"Chen Ji!" Ye Qing cried out, instinctively trying to follow, but was pinned in place by that pressure. Her face instantly turned pale—not for herself, but for the man who was risking his life.

However, Chen Ji smiled.

That smile held no madness, no recklessness—only a composure of one who had the situation fully under control. "Pressure intensity... exactly as I anticipated." His voice echoed in the wind, clear and tranquil, "As long as the speed is sufficient, one won't be completely suppressed."

The altar was right before him, and within that ball of blue light floated an ancient bamboo scroll—that was another portion of the Tianji Record! Chen Ji extended his hand, fingertips about to touch the scroll. However, at that moment, a fierce sword light attacked from the side, forcing him to dodge sideways. "Brat, your greed exceeds my expectations." The ancient voice spoke again, carrying a cold fury, "Since it is so, allow me to show you what true Heavenly Secrets power is!"

Sword light swept across. Chen Ji barely avoided it, yet still had his shoulder grazed by the residual wave, blood splashing. He stumbled back several steps, steadied himself, yet a meaningful curve appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Elder, you're impatient." The ancient voice obviously paused. Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, his smile growing morecomposed: "If you truly possessed absolute power, why bother talking with me? It seems this remnant soul... is not as formidable as you portray."

Silence.

Prolonged silence.

Then, the ancient voice spoke once more, this time carrying a hint of desolate laughter: "Hahaha... good, good, good! Truly a Tianji successor! Your cleverness far exceeds my imagination." The laughter faded, the tone turning cold, "Indeed, my remnant soul is nearly exhausted, but sufficient to complete this final mission—revealing the truth of the Tianji Record to you."

As the words fell, all the white bones on the altar suddenly ceased moving, kneeling reverently on the ground. Meanwhile, the ball of blue light slowly dispersed, revealing the bamboo scrolls floating within. Not just one scroll—but three entire scrolls!

"These are the middle three scrolls of the Tianji Record," the remnant soul's voice echoed through space, "If you can take all of them, you may peer into the true secrets of the Tianji Record. But I must warn you... the more you know, the faster you die. Do you still wish to continue?"

dialogue.content:
Beyond the sealed door lay a profound darkness.

That pressure rushed out like something substantial, Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist compressed nearly against her skin's surface. Her complexion was pale as paper, yet she gritted her teeth and refused to retreat. "Chen Ji," she lowered her voice, "this power... something's wrong." Chen Ji offered no reply, his gaze firmly locked on the vaguely visible light deep within the door. The Tianji Record Fragment's trembling had become an almost frantic躁动, as if something behind the door was calling it—no, summoning it.

"Of course something's wrong." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice surprisingly calm, "Because this door was prepared specifically for the Tianji Record." He turned to glance at Ye Qing, "Do you know what this is called?" Ye Qing shook her head.

"It's called 'inviting the guest into the jar.'"

text.content:
The moment the words fell, the darkness within the door suddenly churned violently.

A figure slowly emerged from the darkness. It was an elderly man wearing a gray robe, his face withered, but his eyes burned with blue flames. No aura leaked from his body, yet he gave off an unfathomable sense of oppression. "Holder of the Tianji Record," the old man's voice was hoarse and cold, "I have waited for you a long time." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes,打量着眼前的老者。灰袍、古纹、幽蓝火焰...这些特征他曾在某本古籍中见过记载—那是上古时期专门负责看守禁地的"守门人"。

"前辈是……"他probing性地开口。

"吾乃天机阁第七代守门人，"老者slowly说道，"奉命在此等候天机录传人。门后所藏，乃是天机录核心篇章——得之者，可窥天道；失之者，必遭天谴。"他顿了顿，枯槁的面容上浮现出一丝诡异的笑容，"汝，准备好接受这份机缘了吗？"

choice.prompt: The Gatekeeper appears, proposing a deal—facing this 'fortune', you choose:

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then raised his head, staring directly into those ethereal blue flame-like eyes. 'Senior,' he began, his voice steady, 'the 'fortune' you speak of is likely not merely a simple gift, is it?' The Gatekeeper said nothing, merely gazing at him. 'The more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the stronger the deadly backlash of destiny,' Chen Ji continued, a self-deprecating curve forming at the corner of his lips, 'I believe this sentence is the true price of this 'fortune'.'

The Gatekeeper's flame-like eyes flickered, seemingly surprised by this answer. 'You are quite perceptive.' A hint of approval emerged in the raspy voice. 'Indeed, the Tianji Record is a manifestation of Heavenly Dao's laws. Those who pry into heavenly secrets will inevitably be counterattacked by those secrets. The more fragments you hold, the stronger the backlash.' He paused, his withered skeletal finger pointing toward the depths beyond the gate. 'But do you know that the three scrolls of the Tianji Record behind this door comprise the complete 'Destiny Deduction Chapter'?'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

The Destiny Deduction Chapter—a legendary supreme technique capable of divining the future! How could it compare to the mere three-hour foresight of the Tianji Record fragments? Its power exceeded them by countless times!

'What's the price?' he asked directly.

The Gatekeeper smiled, that smile cold and merciless: 'Every time you use it, it consumes ten years of your lifespan.'

choices.description: Not rushing to decide, first extract more information about the true nature of the Tianji Record from the Gatekeeper.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he took a half step backward, assuming a thoughtful posture. 'Senior,' he began, his tone respectful yet tinged with cautious probing, 'the disciple has one thing unclear. The Tianji Record is a treasure of Heavenly Dao—why specifically place a Gatekeeper here to wait? Logically speaking, one capable of obtaining the Tianji Record fragments already possesses exceptional talent. Why go through this extra step?' The Gatekeeper's flame-like eyes gazed at him, seemingly judging the true intent behind his words. After a moment, the old man released a raspy laugh: 'You are indeed cautious.'

'The Tianji Record is a manifestation of Heavenly Dao's laws,' the Gatekeeper spoke slowly. 'It cannot be obtained without supreme fortune, nor held without great机缘. However, 'obtaining' and 'holding' are two different matters.' He raised his withered palm, pointing toward the fragments on Chen Ji's chest. 'Though you hold the fragments, you have not yet gained their true recognition. Genuine recognition requires entering this place and undergoing trials.' Chen Ji frowned slightly: 'Trials?' The Gatekeeper nodded: 'Beyond the gate lie three trials—Heart Tribulation, Wisdom Puzzle, and Destiny's Gate. Only by passing all three can you fully control the Tianji Record.' He paused, a meaningful glint flickering in his flame-like eyes. 'Of course, you may also choose to turn and leave. However...'

Ye Qing couldn't help interjecting: 'However what?' The Gatekeeper turned to her, a hint of playful amusement appearing on his withered face: 'However, this young lady of the Demonic Path, the aura of 'Heavenly Fate Lock' on her person... it likely cannot escape the Tianji Record's perception.' Ye Qing's face changed dramatically. Chen Ji noticed her reaction, his heart tightening—Heavenly Fate Lock? That was Chen Nian's characteristic. Why would the Gatekeeper sense it from Ye Qing? Unless... unless Ye Qing had once been in contact with Chen Nian! His gaze turned sharply keen, his eyes toward Ye Qing now carrying more scrutiny. Ye Qing seemed to sense his gaze, lowering her head to avoid his eyes, those violet-black pupils flickering with complex emotions. The atmosphere suddenly became delicate.

The Sealing Gate slowly opened, and an ancient pressure from distant times leaked out.

That pressure was far stronger than Chen Ji's imagination. It was not like ordinary spiritual suppression, but a more fundamental suppression targeting the soul. Just that sliver of leaked aura caused his Tianji Record fragments to convulse violently, as if encountering some kindred existence. 'This aura...' Ye Qing's voice was somewhat strained. She unconsciously moved half a step closer to Chen Ji. 'It resonates with my Demonic Path mists.' Chen Ji did not answer. His full attention was on the faintly glowing light within the gate. The Tianji Record fragments burned on his chest so intensely they seemed ready to pierce through his flesh. The pain was acute and clear, yet carried an odd sense of intimacy—like a wandering child returning home.

'Mister Mo,' he asked in his heart, 'what lies beyond that gate?'

dialogue.content:
'...It is an old friend.' Mister Mo's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, the usually calm tone uncommonly carrying a hint of fluctuation. 'It is also the trial you must face.'

'Old friend?' Chen Ji frowned.

'The Tianji Record consists of nine volumes,' Mister Mo spoke slowly. 'The fragments in your hand are the first volume. What lies sealed beyond the gate are the second and third volumes—they are kept separately precisely to prevent any generation's wielder from becoming too powerful.' He paused, his tone becoming meaningful. 'The second volume is called 'Life Wheel', capable of divining others' fates; the third volume is called 'Calamity Sea', capable of deducing celestial tribulations. The two combined form the complete upper section of the Tianji Record.'

Chen Ji remained silent for a moment: 'And the price?'

Mister Mo's laughter was dry and desolate: 'You still ask that question. The price... wait until you truly obtain it.'

text.content:
Ye Qing suddenly tugged at his sleeve, whispering: 'Chen Ji, the symbols carved on that gate—I recognize them.' Chen Ji turned to look at her. Ye Qing's gaze was firmly fixed on the ancient symbols on the gate, her brow furrowed: 'This is a formation used by ancient Demonic Path sects to seal 'Heavenly Dao anomalies'. I saw related records in the Holy Sect's classics during my childhood.' Her voice dropped even lower. 'It is said that things sealed by this formation were all existence deemed by Heavenly Dao as 'should not exist'.'

Should not exist.

Chen Ji's gaze deepened. The Tianji Record fragments claimed to be capable of divining the future and prying into Heavenly Secrets. If deemed by Heavenly Dao as 'should not exist'... its true origins were probably far more terrifying than he had imagined.

'Interesting.' He spoke softly, a playful curve forming at the corner of his lips. 'It seems the secrets behind this gate are even more numerous than I imagined.'

Just then, the symbols on the Sealing Gate suddenly illuminated.

Those ethereal blue lights flowed slowly along the symbol patterns, as if coming alive. Immediately after, an aged yet dignified voice emerged from beyond the gate, echoing throughout the entire space: 'Tianji successor... you have finally arrived.'

Chen Ji and Ye Qing simultaneously tensed their bodies.

The gate remained closed, yet that voice seemed close at hand, carrying a heart-stopping oppression: 'I am the Guardian of the Tianji Record, commanded to await the destined one here. Since you have come bearing the fragments, you are qualified to receive the final legacy—' The voice paused, the tone suddenly turning cold. 'But before that, you must first pass my trial.'

As the words fell, the symbols on the Sealing Gate blazed brilliantly. An even more intense pressure than before poured out from the gate's cracks. Chen Ji's Tianji Record fragments convulsed violently at this moment, as if responding to something.

'The trial... begins now.'

The light dispersed, and the Sealing Gate burst open.

Beyond the gate lay a profound void. At its center floated an ancient altar. On the altar rested a yellowed bamboo slip, covered densely with symbols, each symbol radiating a faint golden light. That golden light shared the same essence as the Tianji Record fragments, yet was concentrated by countless times.

'Second volume...' Chen Ji murmured, his eyes flickering with complex light.

'Not so fast.' The aged voice spoke again. 'Before you obtain it, you must first answer my question.' Within the void, a blurry figure slowly formed—that of an elderly man in white robes, his benevolent face yet carrying an undeniable dignity. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, as if wanting to pierce through all his secrets.

'Do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?'

Chen Ji fell silent.

He had never seriously contemplated the answer to this question. He only knew that on some day he suddenly obtained the Tianji Record fragments, and then possessed the ability to foresee the future. As for why it was him... he had never probed deeply. Or rather, he dared not probe deeply.

'I know what you are thinking.' The white-robed elder's voice echoed in the void, carrying a meaningful smile. 'You are thinking this was merely a random coincidence, an arrangement of destiny, some unknowable fortune.' He shook his head. 'Wrong.'

'The Tianji Record selects its master never at random.' The elder's gaze became deep and sharp. 'The reason you were chosen is because there is something on your body—it is what attracted the Tianji Record's attention.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly.

'Do you wish to
